notes.title: Horns of fear is out !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30907685/087e202dd66d5a758411962e71564595e3337600.gif[/img]

Horns of Fear is a third-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious mansion. 
You are Jim Sonrimor, a journalist fascinated by the paranormal.
Your phone rings one night. The caller invites you to a strange mansion, bordering a forest with a gruesome reputation. Without hesitation, you drive off to visit the place...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30907685/44feb1548c30b94d2b5ad9634b3448cce8404660.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30907685/6951c442691a57d1d653823de1888d80d4527965.jpg[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/720940/Horns_of_Fear/

Embark on this terrifying journey and unravel the mysteries hidden within the mansion.
